name: Witch Doctor: Sen'jin's Apprentice and Voodoo Power convert stats natively (#761, #782)
contract: Sen'jin's Apprentice 681199: three SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects, all stock aura types with generic engine consumers, no module code involved (confirmed absent from spell_script_names, mod-ascension-compat and src/server/scripts). Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT (212), MiscValue 3 (Intellect), BasePoints 99 (real 100 with DieSides 1). Effect 1 is the same aura, MiscValue 1 (Agility), BasePoints 24 (real 25). Effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (174), MiscValue 127 (all schools), MiscValueB 1 (Agility), BasePoints 24 (real 25). Effects 0-1 are summed generically in Unit::UpdateAttackPowerAndDamage (StatSystem.cpp) via GetAuraEffectsByType(SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT); effect 2 is summed generically in Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp), which the harness's spell_power metric calls directly. Voodoo Power 706482: two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects, same pattern. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT (220), MiscValue 128 (bit 7, CR_HIT_SPELL, Unit.h), MiscValueB 4 (Spirit), BasePoints 4 (real 5); consumed generically in Player::UpdateRating (PlayerUpdates.cpp) via GetAuraEffectsByType(SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (174), MiscValue 127, MiscValueB 4 (Spirit), BasePoints 49 (real 50), same generic consumer as above. All DBC fields re-verified directly against the installed Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer in this session (ids 681199, 706482), not taken from the issue bodies or the investigator's report alone. Each assertion checks the actual post-learn total (ranged_attack_power, spell_power, combat_rating) moved off its pre-learn baseline in the same run and returned to it on unlearn, plus the aura's own live percentage (aura_amount) against the DBC-derived tooltip number, so a broken handler, a wrong DBC percentage or a dropped effect all fail this scenario.

steps.label: Let level scaling settle
Sen'jin's Apprentice not yet known
Ranged attack power before Sen'jin's Apprentice
Shadow spell power before Sen'jin's Apprentice
Self-buff is present
Ranged attack power rises (100% Intellect + 25% Agility)
Shadow spell power rises (25% Agility)

Effect 1 grants 25% of Agility to ranged attack power
Effect 2 grants 25% of Agility to spell power
Unlearning removes the self-buff
Ranged attack power returns to baseline
Shadow spell power returns to baseline
